subtitle.zh: Jupyter × Python × Blender × Processing 协同设计
subtitle.en: A design workflow connecting Jupyter, Python, Blender, and Processing

description.zh: 以 Python 连接图像、文本与地震记录，将多源数据转化为空间生成规则和动态行为。
description.en: Python connects images, text, and seismic records, translating multimodal data into spatial generation rules and dynamic behaviour.

kind.zh: Bartlett School 设计项目 · 数据驱动设计
kind.en: Bartlett School design project · Data-driven design

coverAlt.zh: 深色空间中数据生成的建筑碎片、地表裂隙与发光震中波纹。
coverAlt.en: Data-generated architectural fragments, ground fractures, and luminous epicentral waves in a dark space.

role.zh: Python 数据处理、参数映射与空间可视化
role.en: Python data processing, design mappings, and spatial visualisation

stage.zh: 多源分析、程序建模与实时可视化
stage.en: Multimodal analysis, procedural modelling, and real-time visualisation

deliverables.zh: Jupyter 分析、特征与聚类图、数据映射 CSV、Blender 生成模型与 Processing 动态反馈
deliverables.en: Jupyter analyses, feature and cluster plots, mapping CSV, Blender-generated models, and Processing feedback

overview.zh: 以地震为主题，将图像中的视觉特征、文本中的叙事信号与地球物理记录转化为可计算的设计变量。在 Jupyter 中完成采集、清洗、分析与融合，再用 Python 将这些变量映射为 Blender 的建筑碎片、地表裂隙与动态场景，最终在 Processing 中转化为粒子、波纹与实时反馈。
overview.en: This earthquake study turns visual features, narrative signals, and geophysical records into computable design variables. Collection, cleaning, analysis, and fusion in Jupyter lead to Python-driven architectural fragments, ground fractures, and animated scenes in Blender, followed by particles, waves, and real-time feedback in Processing.

title.zh: 从数据到设计的工作流
